_note: JSON has no comments, so the reasoning that would normally sit beside a
value lives here and in the <link rel="manifest"> comment in index.html.
EVERY PATH IN THIS FILE IS RELATIVE, and that is not a style preference.
BookTrak is published at ackley14.github.io/Lorelaibrary/, so a leading
slash resolves to the origin root — which is MovieTrak's neighbourhood, not
ours — and the installed app would launch into a 404. Relative paths are
resolved against the URL of this file, so they are correct from the subpath,
from a repository renamed tomorrow, and from a local static server. There is
no build step to rewrite them, so they have to be right as written.
`id` is deliberately absent. It defaults to start_url, which keeps the
installed app's identity tied to wherever the manifest actually is; naming
it explicitly would hardcode /Lorelaibrary/ and split one installed app into
two the day the repository is renamed.
A manifest takes ONE colour pair while the app has two grounds. The dark one
wins: this is a scanning tool that is used in shops and libraries, the splash
screen shows for a beat before the theme script in index.html has run, and a
white flash on a dark-themed phone is the more jarring of the two mistakes.
#071619 is --bt-surface-canvas of the dark theme (css/01-tokens.css) and must
change with it, along with the two theme-color meta tags in index.html.
